title: Future forms review
note: Choice unit: will / going to / present cont·simple future / future cont / future perfect / time clauses · includes future-in-the-past (would / was going to / about to) · thin shell 2026-08-06

cards.title: Future forms — choose, don’t re-teach
cards.title_cz: Budoucí tvary — volba, ne znovu učení
cards.body: At B2 you already know the forms. This unit is about **which form fits the meaning**: plan, prediction, arrangement, process in the future, completed before a future point, and **future seen from the past** (would / was going to).
cards.body_cz: Na B2 tvary znáte. Jde o **který tvar sedí k významu**: plán, předpověď, domluva, proces v budoucnosti, hotové před budoucím bodem a **budoucnost z minulosti** (would / was going to).

items.en: I think it will rain later.
accepts: I think it will rain later.

items.en: We're going to move house next year.
accepts: We're going to move house next year.
We are going to move house next year.
items.explanation: Prior plan / intention: be going to.
items.explanation_cz: Dřívější plán / záměr: be going to.

items.en: I'm meeting the client at three.
items.cz: V tři se setkám s klientem.
accepts: I'm meeting the client at three.
I am meeting the client at three.
items.explanation: Fixed arrangement: present continuous for future.

items.en: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to Rome.
items.cz: Zítra v tuhle dobu budu letět do Říma.
items.gap: This time tomorrow I'll ____ to Rome.
accepts: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to Rome.
This time tomorrow I will be flying to Rome.
items.explanation: Action in progress at a future point: future continuous.
items.explanation_cz: Děj v průběhu v budoucím bodě: future continuous.

items.en: By Friday she will have finished the report.
items.cz: Do pátku bude mít zprávu hotovou.
items.gap: By Friday she will ____ the report.
accepts: By Friday she will have finished the report.
items.explanation: Completed before a future time: future perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Hotovo před budoucím časem: future perfect.

items.en: I'll call you when I arrive.
accepts: I'll call you when I arrive.
I will call you when I arrive.
items.explanation: Time clause with future meaning: present simple after when.
items.explanation_cz: Časová věta s budoucím významem: přítomný prostý po when.

items.en: I thought it would rain later.
accepts: I thought it would rain later.
items.explanation: Future in the past: would + base.

items.en: She was going to call, but she forgot.
items.gap: She ____ going to call, but she forgot.
accepts: She was going to call, but she forgot.
items.explanation: Past plan / abandoned intention: was/were going to.

items.en: We were about to leave when he arrived.
items.cz: Už jsme skoro odcházeli, když dorazil.
items.gap: We ____ about to leave when he arrived.
accepts: We were about to leave when he arrived.

items.explanation_cz: Jízdní řád: přítomný prostý pro budoucnost.
